class_guess: Bell eats counter, partial eat with residue (sibling of #10)
summary: Marker bounce feeds a 3-cell binary counter; the bell eats only its low digit, so residue seeds the next epoch
mechanism: Hub K(a,b,X) = (110)^a 0 (011)^b C> X: each bounce moves the 0-marker one block and adds 1 to counter X.
Clean counter D(k,s,v): digits ?01 split by 001000, 4-stage tail; when b runs out only the low digit is eaten (E1/E2).
The rest seeds the next epoch as residue; forcing an eat during its digestion can halt, so we need eat time > digestion time.

vars: k (left record; next epoch has b = k+1)

rules.name: R restart
rules.cases: any Y not starting with 011; k <= 3000

rules.name: B bounce
rules.cases: b >= 1; X = any of 9,730 orbit hub words; inc(X), d in {0,1} and c(X) do not depend on a, b

rules.name: E2 odd eat
rules.cases: E(0,s,0)=tail_s, E(j,s,u)=001000 D(j,s,u); u+1=2^j overflows to s+1; j <= 9

rules.name: E1 even eat
rules.cases: i >= 1 (i <= 40 tested), Y random / orbit / clean words not starting with 011

rules.name: digestion (open)
rules.cases: not exact yet: inc on words with extra 001 groups; forced eats halt at 1-2 bounce counts inside this window

template.note: RInc (marker bounce) = our B. LInc (2-cell counter) and Ov/P0 (whole counter eaten, fractal doubling k -> 2k+3) do not hold: our counter has 3-cell digits + 4-stage tail and the eat is partial (E1/E2), leaving residue. Same hub as #10 (STUCK on Lemma X).

strategy: Deepen: exact rules for digestion and for counters with extra 001 groups, then an abstract epoch map (N, residue) -> (N', residue') checked against the TM, then prove 'digestion < N' as an inductive size invariant; proof shaped like FractalBEC/BECv7.
risks: Digestion may not close into a short rule list (as #10's Lemma X).
Safety is not regular (random eat times halt), so no CTL shortcut.
Non-clean counters (75/138 eats) may hide further cases.
